title: Observed outcome gauges; not geopolitical influence scores

metrics.label: EU imports of U.S. gas
metrics.note: EU natural gas imports, pipeline and LNG combined; volume is not company profit.

metrics.label: EU imports of Russian gas
metrics.note: 2021 value approximate; declining EU gas imports do not measure Russia's global revenues.

metrics.label: EU Russian gas import reduction
metrics.note: Reduction in Russian import volume relative to 2021; not Russia's share of all EU imports.

metrics.label: China Phase One purchase fulfillment
metrics.note: 2020–2021 combined commitment fulfillment, not a change from zero in 2020 or a China influence score.

metrics.label: U.S. federal customs duties
metrics.note: Federal fiscal receipts, not net national benefit or tariff-incidence accounting.

metrics.label: Indian imports of Russian crude
metrics.note: 2020 baseline approximate; imports measure supply sourcing, not net economic gain.

scoringPolicy: Each gauge is a separately scaled observed outcome. No aggregation, country ranking, influence score, or readiness adjustment.
